quotes.text: Repair the interaction rather than adding arbitrary waits: `await dialog.show()` for geometry-dependent tests, click the visible `label[for="maybe"]`, and synchronize `files/calendarDialog.xhtml` with `calendarDialogAcceptanceTemplate.inc.xhtml`. Attendee rows render through `scheduler.postTask`, so wait with `TestUtils.waitForCondition()` before reading the matching attendee.
